sql:
SELECT
  fp.title,
  dc.company_name,
  fp.published_at
FROM fct_posting AS fp
JOIN dim_company AS dc
  ON fp.company_key = dc.company_key
WHERE
  fp.is_open = TRUE AND fp.remote_us = TRUE
ORDER BY
  fp.published_at ASC
LIMIT 1
